text_block_list.text:
While walking around the academy, I heard 
a familiar voice—along with some 
unfamiliar words.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Loving Umamusume?
text_block_list.text:
Mnyunyuyu~... This little kitty~ is so 
cute~~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*Haaah*... It really blows away all kinds 
of fati—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: Sorry for getting in the way...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I wonder if Trainer's memories 
will get blown away too?! Mr. Kitty!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... No good, that just made me... 
even more exhausted...

It seems she's tired and out of energy. 
For the sake of her future success, should 
I reconsider her upcoming race 
schedule...?
